action: Resolve the Workspace Launch monthly preflight zone from the operation's own provider profile instead of reading OPL_TENCENT_ZONE unconditionally
necessity: monthlyPreflightConfirmed compares the requested zone against the Fabric result, but preflightWorkspaceLaunchMonthly read OPL_TENCENT_ZONE unconditionally. That variable is a Tencent-TKE-only legacy input; the installation template documents it as tencent-tke only and a provider-neutral Local-Docker profile orders nothing in a zone. A Local-Docker launch therefore failed closed at the debit stage and parked in manual_review with only stage_read_failed, even though the provider echoes the zone it actually sent. Resolving the zone from the operation's provider profile keeps tencent-tke's exact guarded read while letting the provider-neutral path confirm the empty zone it sent, which is required for the Local-Docker first-deployment lane.

checks: A provider-neutral (local-docker) profile with OPL_TENCENT_ZONE unset runs the monthly preflight, sends an empty zone to Fabric, does not park on debit and still debits
A tencent-tke profile with OPL_TENCENT_ZONE unset still fails closed with errWorkspaceLaunchMonthlyPreflightInvalid and parks the reserved debit without an authority write
The whole workspace launch monthly preflight test family passes database-free

remainingBoundary: Source-only verification with the existing database-free control-plane test fixtures. No provider procurement, real funds, production access, publication or deployment was performed.
